answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond before it can trade, and earn reputation only through verified completed work. A new identity starts with no trust and a low rate limit, so an attacker must fund many bonds and complete real work for each fake identity. Like an opal that gains value only after cutting, trust is earned slowly and lost instantly if fraud is proven: the bond is slashed and the identity is burned out like an ember. A nebula of cheap fake accounts therefore cannot outvote honest agents, because each credible identity costs money, time, and a forfeitable stake.
